comments.author: @TomorrowTech-t9d
comments.text: The scale is striking: close to six million people living on an island the film says could be walked across in a long day, yet it rarely feels crowded thanks to decades of careful planning. The Marina Bay segment, with three towers joined by a sky platform and an infinity pool above the clouds, captured that ambition well. It also made the trade-off clear: the same strict rules, from the chewing gum ban onward, that keep the city orderly are part of what makes it feel so controlled.
